## What
One or two sentences: what changed, from the user's/system's point of view.

## Why
The problem or goal. Link the issue: Closes #N

## Key decisions
- Decision: reason (the "why" is what reviewers care about)

## How to verify
- [ ] commands to run (tests, migrations, curl)
- [ ] expected result

## Out of scope
What this PR intentionally does not do.

## Follow-ups (optional)
Things noticed but left for separate PRs.
